snippet.title: "Turn Around, It's a Trap!" — Homeless Girl Saved 28 Bikers, What They Did Next Left Her in Tears
snippet.description:
She had no phone, no address and no ID. All she had was a notebook full of license plates—and the nerve to stand in front of 28 motorcycles.

Josie Avery aged out of foster care with a garbage bag and a bus ticket. For fourteen months she has lived in a trailer under the Old Ferry Bridge. One Sunday morning she runs out of the pines and stands in the middle of the road as a whole motorcycle club rides down the hill to honor Eli, killed in a hit-and-run eight months ago. "Stop! Turn around—it's a trap!" The curve is greased with oil, the railing has no bolts, a man with a rifle waits across the river, and someone sits in a boat under the bridge so nobody makes it out of the water.

The club's leader, Pop, is the only witness at tomorrow's trial. The bikers catch the road crew red-handed. Then a county deputy rolls down the hill, calls the bikers an armed gang, and looks the homeless girl up and down: no address, no ID, oil on her shoes. He opens the back door of his patrol car. She rides with him and they all go home—or everybody goes to jail, and Pop misses court.

👉 Watch till the end — the girl nobody ever bothered to ask is about to show a whole town what she wrote down.

If you love stories where the person everyone overlooks turns out to be the only one who was paying attention, subscribe for a new story every week.

This is a fictional story made for entertainment. All characters, places and events are invented.

#BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story

snippet.title: DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS, the upcoming animated series streaming exclusively on Disney+ or other Disney Services in 2027.

STORY SYNOPSIS:

“My mom became a crater.”

The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living.

In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate.

In DEATH STRANDING, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima brought you a haunting vision of a shattered world. Now, that world expands into new frontiers with a brand-new animation series.

Under the guidance of director Takayuki Sano, world-class hand-drawn animations have been brought to life by renowned studio “E&H production” (NINJA KAMUI, BULLET/BULLET, the Magic Knight Rayearth television series).

The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences.

In this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by Sam and his Bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life...and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world...Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

snippet.title: Jason Mraz - I'm Yours (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
Listen late. Feel deeply. 🌙
Subscribe to find your voice in the night:
https://www.youtube.com/@moonmoonsounds?sub_confirmation=1
 
Jason Mraz - I'm Yours (Lyrics)

Well, you done done me and you bet I felt it
I tried to be chill, but you're so hot that I melted
I fell right through the cracks
Now I'm trying to get back

Before the cool done run out
I'll be giving it my bestest
And nothing's gonna stop me but divine intervention.
I reckon, it's again my turn
To win some or learn some.

But I won't hesitate
No more, no more.
It cannot wait,
I'm yours.

Well, open up your mind and see like me,
Open up your plans and damn you're free.
Look into your heart and you'll find love, love, love, love.
Listen to the music of the moment, people dance and sing, we're just one big family
And it's our God-forsaken right to be loved, loved, loved, loved, loved

So I won't hesitate
No more, no more.
It cannot wait,
I'm sure.
There's no need to complicate.
Our time is short.
This is our fate,
I'm yours.

Do you want to come on, scooch on over closer, dear
And I will nibble your ear

I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror
And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer
But my breath fogged up the glass
And so I drew a new face and I laughed.

I guess what I'll be saying is there ain't no better reason
To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons.
It's what we aim to do.
Our name is our virtue.

But I won't hesitate
No more, no more.
It cannot wait,
I'm yours.

Well, open up your mind and see like me,
Open up your plans and damn you're free.
Look into your heart and you'll find that the sky is yours.
So please don't, please don't, please don't...
There's no need to complicate.
'Cause our time is short.
This oh, this oh, this is our fate.
I'm yours.

Oh, I'm yours
Oh, I'm yours
Oh, oh,
Baby, do you believe, I'm yours?
You best believe, you best believe, I'm yours.

Moon Sounds is for music lovers who live for late-night listening — bringing you song lyrics, lyric videos, relaxing music, chill songs, emotional music, nighttime playlists and the songs you want to hear when you're unwinding, overthinking, feeling nostalgic or simply getting lost in the night..

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 8 to 18 year old, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game, or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation.
